output_file.description: Full path of the first ttyrec file to write to.

output_dir.description: Folder where to write the ttyrec files.

session_uuid.description: UUID string that will appear in the ttyrec output file names, and kept with SIGUSR1 rotations. Use 'auto' for default PID-based behavior.

name_format.description: Custom strftime-compatible format string to qualify the full path of the output files, including the SIGUSR1 rotated ones.

append_mode.description: Open the ttyrec output file in append mode instead of write-clobber mode.

enable_zstd.description: Force on-the-fly compression of output file using zstd.

zstd_max_flush_time.description: Maximum number of seconds after which zstd will force flush its output buffers.

compression_level.description: Compression level, must be between 1 and 19 for zstd.

count_bytes.description: Count the number of bytes out and print it on termination.

lock_timeout.description: Lock session on input timeout after S seconds. 0 disables.

kill_timeout.description: Kill session on input timeout after S seconds. 0 disables.

no_openpty.description: Don't use openpty() even when it's available.

command.description: Command to be executed by ttyrec. Note: ttyrec syntax is 'ttyrec [options] -- <command>'.
